evidence.title: Elizabeth City Regional Airport
evidence.text: Elizabeth City Regional Airport (IATA: ECG, ICAO: KECG, FAA LID: ECG) is a joint civil-military public and military use airport located three nautical miles (6 km) southeast of the central business district of Elizabeth City, in Pasquotank County, North Carolina, United States.

evidence.title: Elizabeth City Regional Airport
evidence.text: The airport, on the shore of the Pasquotank River, is also known as Elizabeth City-Pasquotank County Regional Airport or ECG Regional Airport.

evidence.title: Elizabeth City Regional Airport
evidence.text: It is included in the National Plan of Integrated Airport Systems for 2011–2015, which categorized it as a "general aviation" facility.

evidence.title: Southwest Oregon Regional Airport
evidence.text: It is operated by the Coos County Airport District.

evidence.title: History of Lawton, Oklahoma
evidence.text: The History of Lawton, Oklahoma refers to the history of the southwestern Oklahoma city of Lawton, Oklahoma.

evidence.title: History of Lawton, Oklahoma
evidence.text: Lawton's history starts with opening of American Indian reservation lands in the early 1900s and has seen population and economic growth throughout the 20th Century due to its proximity with Fort Sill.

evidence.title: Coast Guard Air Station North Bend
evidence.text: Coast Guard Air Station North Bend (CGAS North Bend) was established September 28, 1974 at Southwest Oregon Regional Airport in North Bend, Oregon, United States.

evidence.title: Coast Guard Air Station North Bend
evidence.text: The unit houses 153 active duty, nine reserve duty and five civilian personnel.

evidence.title: Coast Guard Air Station North Bend
evidence.text: The unit operates five Eurocopter HH-65 Dolphin helicopters.

evidence.title: Coast Guard Air Station North Bend
evidence.text: CGAS North Bend received its first upgraded HH-65C Dolphin in 2007 The unit functions include search and rescue, law enforcement, marine environmental protection, aids to navigation, and enforcement of federal treaties.

evidence.title: Eastern Oregon Regional Airport
evidence.text: Eastern Oregon Regional Airport (IATA: PDT, ICAO: KPDT, FAA LID: PDT) (Eastern Oregon Regional Airport at Pendleton) is a city-owned public airport three miles northwest of Pendleton, in Umatilla County, Oregon.

evidence.title: Eastern Oregon Regional Airport
evidence.text: It is used for general aviation and by one airline subsidized by the Essential Air Service program.

evidence.title: Lawton–Fort Sill Regional Airport
evidence.text: Lawton–Fort Sill Regional Airport (IATA: LAW, ICAO: KLAW, FAA LID: LAW) is a city owned airport two miles south of Lawton, in Comanche County, Oklahoma.

evidence.title: Lawton–Fort Sill Regional Airport
evidence.text: It is used for military aviation from nearby Fort Sill and Sheppard Air Force Base and is served by American Eagle.

evidence.title: Lawton–Fort Sill Regional Airport
evidence.text: Allegiant Air runs occasional charters to various destinations in the western United States.

evidence.title: Stafford Regional Airport
evidence.text: Stafford Regional Airport (ICAO: KRMN, FAA LID: RMN) is a public airport located three miles (5 km) southwest of the central business district of Stafford, the county seat of Stafford County, Virginia, United States.

evidence.title: Stafford Regional Airport
evidence.text: The airport is southwest of the intersection of Route 630 and U.S. Route 1 near Interstate 95, approximately 40 mi south of Washington, D.C. and 60 mi north of Richmond.

evidence.title: Stafford Regional Airport
evidence.text: It is owned and operated by the Stafford Regional Airport Authority, an independent body of representatives from Stafford and Prince William Counties and the City of Fredericksburg.

evidence.title: Manassas Regional Airport
evidence.text: Manassas Regional Airport (IATA: KHEF, ICAO: HEF) , also known as Harry P. Davis Field, is a city-owned public-use airport located four nautical miles (7 km) southwest of the central business district of Manassas, in a section of Manassas that was carved out of Prince William County specifically for the purpose of containing the airport.

evidence.title: Manassas Regional Airport
evidence.text: The largest regional airport in the state of Virginia, Manassas Regional Airport is located 30 miles from Washington, D.C.

evidence.title: Lawton High School (Oklahoma)
evidence.text: Lawton High School (LHS) was the first high school built in Lawton, Oklahoma.

evidence.title: Lawton High School (Oklahoma)
evidence.text: Lawton High is located at 601 Northwest Fort Sill Boulevard in Lawton, Oklahoma.

evidence.title: Lawton High School (Oklahoma)
evidence.text: The school was originally housed in a building on 800 Southwest 'C' Avenue, which later came to be the Central Junior High building until the junior high was also moved to 1201 Northwest Fort Sill Boulevard.

evidence.title: Lawton High School (Oklahoma)
evidence.text: Old Lawton High School on C Avenue is listed on the National Register of Historic Places.

evidence.title: Hammerfest Airport
evidence.text: Hammerfest Airport (Norwegian: "Hammerfest lufthavn" ; IATA: HFT, ICAO: ENHF ) is a regional airport at Prærien in Hammerfest, Norway.

evidence.title: Hammerfest Airport
evidence.text: It is operated by the state-owned Avinor and handled 145,396 passengers in 2014, making it the third-busiest regional airport in the country.

evidence.title: Hammerfest Airport
evidence.text: The airport has a 880 m runway aligned 05/23.

evidence.title: Hammerfest Airport
evidence.text: Services are provided by Widerøe using the Dash 8-100.

evidence.title: Hammerfest Airport
evidence.text: Up to eight daily flights are provided to Tromsø and public service obligation flights are flown eastwards to other airports in Finnmark.

evidence.title: Hammerfest Airport
evidence.text: The airport is the base for offshore helicopter services operated by Bristow Norway and CHC Helikopter Service.

evidence.title: Hammerfest Airport
evidence.text: An estimated 40,000 people from Hammerfest Airport's catchment area annually use Alta Airport for flights to Oslo.
